source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        marks = [c for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]\n        for left, right in zip(marks, marks[1:]):\n            for c in range(left + 1, right):\n                if grid[r][c] == 0:\n                    out[r][c] = 2\n    return out\n'''
